investigation.findings: When sending media via whatsapp-web.js, mediaOptions.toJSON() has an internal id: undefined property that was spread onto the message object after id: newMsgKey, wiping out message.id. When WhatsApp Web called its internal collection getter Msg.get(message.id), it threw 'Data passed to getter must include an id property ... but got undefined'.
investigation.root_cause: CONFIRMED: Object spread order in whatsapp-web.js Injected/Utils.js caused mediaOptions.toJSON().id (undefined) to overwrite message.id (newMsgKey). Fixed via reproducible postinstall script applying fallback guard `if (!message.id) message.id = newMsgKey;`.
